# CommandCode

Use `commandcode/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "commandcode-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "commandcode/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2.5",
});
```

## Environment variables

- `CMD_API_KEY`

## Provider package

`@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`

This provider uses the OpenAI-compatible adapter.

## Default base URL

`https://api.commandcode.ai/provider/v1`

You can override the base URL by setting `COMMANDCODE_BASE_URL`.

## Provider docs

- https://commandcode.ai/docs/provider
